data.question_title: Two putty balls of equal mass moving with equal velocity in mutually perpendicular directions, stick together after collision. If the balls were initially moving with a velocity of \(45 \sqrt { 2 } \mathrm { ms } ^ { - 1 }\) each, the velocity of their combined mass after collision is
data.explanation_txt:
Initial momentum

\(\vec { P } = m 45 \sqrt { 2 } \hat { i } + m 45 \sqrt { 2 } \hat { j } \Rightarrow | \vec { P } | = m \times 90\)

Final momentum \(2 m \times V\)

By conservation of momentum \(2 m \times V = m \times 90\)

\(\therefore\) V = 45 m/s
